# Vivek Yadav

> Portfolio of Vivek Yadav — Full Stack Developer & Systems Engineer building scalable web applications, real-time architectures, and IoT solutions.

## Summary
Vivek Yadav is a software engineer based in Gurugram, India. He builds production-grade web systems, high-concurrency backends, responsive client applications, and embedded IoT firmware. His core stack includes HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, and C++ for microcontrollers.

## Featured Projects
- [CognitoAttend](https://vivek-yadav.com/project-cognitoattend.html): Cognitive facial recognition and attendance automation platform with real-time verification.
- [JhatpatSewa](https://vivek-yadav.com/project-jhatpatsewa.html): Full-scale on-demand home service marketplace featuring real-time provider matching, payment integration, and relational database architecture.
- [NeoRide](https://vivek-yadav.com/project-neoride.html): Pure DOM-rendered driving physics engine built without graphics or canvas assets.
- [Star Cadet](https://vivek-yadav.com/project-starcadet.html): HTML5 Canvas space simulation platform engineered for consistent 60 FPS performance.
- [MediaConverter](https://vivek-yadav.com/project-mediaconverter.html): High-speed client-side and server-backed media processing and transcoding tool.
- [NeoStream](https://vivek-yadav.com/project-neostream.html): Real-time multimedia streaming and playback dashboard.

## Technical Skills & Stack

- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Laravel, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Microservices
- Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Supabase, Firebase
- Systems & IoT: ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, MQTT, HTTP/REST, Sensor Networks, Serial Protocols
- Developer Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux/Unix shell, Postman, Apache/Nginx
